name: DaSiWa MiniMax H3: Hybrid v3 (int4, for 12 GB cards)
author: Darksidewalker
note: The same hybrid stored in int4 ConvRot: 11.7 GB instead of 19.5, a little detail lost. For a card with 12 GB of VRAM, or less room on disk. His settings, set here: res_multistep/simple, shift 11 video and 4 sound, 24 steps. Rechecked against his page on 5 October 2026.
